description: Verification-first feature delivery with explicit design, tests, product proof and independent review.

nodes.objective: Turn the request into outcome, acceptance criteria, non-goals, risk and verification plan.
acceptance: Acceptance criteria are observable and falsifiable.

nodes.objective: Map relevant code, history, docs, existing patterns and constraints before edits.
acceptance: Relevant ownership and call paths are identified.
Unknowns that can change the design are resolved or listed.

nodes.objective: Settle boundaries, data shapes, state ownership and dependency direction.
acceptance: The design does not add avoidable machinery.

nodes.objective: Create failing or baseline tests for the requested behavior where feasible.
acceptance: The test fails or baseline evidence is captured before implementation.
The test represents the acceptance criteria rather than implementation details.

nodes.objective: Implement the smallest coherent change that satisfies the architecture and tests.
acceptance: Change is scoped to the requested outcome.
Relevant tests/typecheck/lint/build pass or failures are documented as blockers.

nodes.objective: Operate the real product or closest faithful environment and prove the user-visible outcome.
acceptance: Acceptance criteria are demonstrated with runtime evidence.

nodes.objective: Independently try to falsify correctness, architecture and safety.
acceptance: Independent findings are recorded before synthesis.

nodes.objective: Resolve findings, rerun affected gates and prepare reviewable closeout.
acceptance: All blocking findings are resolved or escalated.
Final evidence maps to each acceptance criterion.
